2607.21143.title: One More Turn, Less Regret: A Regret-Based Multi-Turn Benchmark for LLMs' Clarification Policies
2607.21143.paper_summary: Ambiguous user requests make clarification a sequential decision problem for conversational LLM assistants: they must decide whether to ask, what to ask, when to stop, and when to answer. We introduce RegretBench, a multi-turn benchmark that evaluates clarification as policy behavior rather than isolated question quality. RegretBench provides a hidden-intent formulation of ambiguity, supports free-form interaction grounded in semantic-state tracking, and introduces a regret-based objective that measures how much value a model loses relative to a reference clarification policy. Experiments on open-domain QA and product recommendation scenarios show that final success alone is insufficient, as models with similar accuracy can differ substantially in efficiency, robustness to user behaviors, and stopping decisions. By jointly measuring intent resolution, interaction cost, ineffective clarification, and regret, RegretBench reveals whether models clarify usefully and efficiently. Our results show that effective clarification requires more than plausible questions: models must ask the right question at the right time and stop once the user's intended meaning is clear.
2607.21143.paper_summary_zh: 模糊的用戶請求使得澄清成為對話式 LLM 助手的一個序列決策問題：它們必須決定是否詢問、詢問什麼、何時停止以及何時回答。<lb/>我們引入了 RegretBench，一個多輪基準，評估澄清作為政策行為，而不是孤立的問題質量。<lb/>RegretBench 提供了一種隱藏意圖的模糊性表述，支持基於語義狀態跟蹤的自由形式互動，並引入了一個基於後悔的目標，衡量模型相對於參考澄清政策所損失的價值。<lb/>在開放領域的 QA 和產品推薦場景中的實驗顯示，僅僅最終成功是不夠的，因為具有相似準確性的模型在效率、對用戶行為的魯棒性和停止決策上可能有顯著差異。<lb/>通過共同衡量意圖解析、互動成本、無效澄清和後悔，RegretBench 揭示了模型是否有效且高效地進行澄清。<lb/>我們的結果顯示，有效的澄清需要的不僅僅是合理的問題：模型必須在正確的時間提出正確的問題，並在用戶的意圖明確後停止。
